description: This file contains functions and logic for managing plugin skills, including resolving plugin directories, normalizing plugin IDs, and handling plugin registry data within the 'skills' subsystem.

methods.name: buildRegistryPluginIdAliases
methods.description: Builds a mapping of plugin provider IDs and legacy plugin IDs to their main plugin ID for a given registry.

methods.name: createRegistryPluginIdNormalizer
methods.description: Creates a function to normalize plugin IDs based on registry aliases.

methods.name: resolvePluginSkillDirs
methods.description: Resolves and returns the directories of plugin skills based on the provided workspace directory and configuration.
